name: 1" Safety Breakaway Polyester Lanyards
description: Make sure your logo hangs around for a while with this great lanyard! Made of polyester, each lanyard measures 36" x 1" and comes in an assortment of great colors. It features a breakaway safety release and has ample room to add an imprinted brand name, logo or message. This item is appropriate for trade shows, office buildings, hospitals, schools, sports teams and more. People will think of you with every wear!
summary: Breakaway lanyards provide an added safety feature, disconnecting under pressure to eliminate choking risks
